info.title: Zennopay Partner API
info.description: QR Payments and Platform Payouts for Zennopay partners. Server-to-server calls are HMAC-signed. QR Payments uses short-lived client session tokens for user-initiated SDK calls. Platform Payouts uses asynchronous server-to-server resources funded from an environment-scoped prefund balance.

servers.description: Live API host currently serving partner traffic. See /api-reference/environments.
Sandbox API host. Sandbox HMAC keys only.

post.description: Create a new payment intent. Server-to-server only; requires HMAC signing.

201.description: Intent created. Response carries the Zennopay-minted session token.

post.description: Submit the raw QR payload for authoritative validation and quote binding. Called by PaymentSheet with an intent-bound session token.

Mint a fresh session token for an existing intent. Server-to-server only; requires HMAC. The partner identified by the HMAC key must own the intent, and it must not be in a terminal state. Zennopay preserves the intent's scan/quote/confirm state across the re-mint. Drives the SDK's `refreshSession` hook.

Mint a read-only, reusable receipt token so the SDK can reopen the authoritative receipt for a past payment. Server-to-server only; requires HMAC and **no request body**. The partner identified by the HMAC key must own `{intent_id}`; a cross-partner or unknown intent id returns an identical `404` with no existence leak. The token's `sub` is derived from the stored intent's `partner_user_id` (not supplied by the caller), so the token is scoped to that user and can open any of that user's receipts — but no one else's.

get.description: Fetch the current state of a payment intent. Accepts either HMAC (server-side) or the session token issued for this specific intent. A session token bound to intent A cannot be used to fetch intent B.

Fetch the authoritative, branded receipt for a payment intent with its live status. Called by the Zennopay SDK inside `presentReceipt`; partners usually don't call it directly. **Receipt-token only** — authorize with a Zennopay-minted receipt token (from POST /v1/payment_intents/{intent_id}/receipt_token) sent as a bearer credential. The token is read-only, reusable, and scoped to a user (not intent-bound). A receipt token scoped to one user returns `404` for any intent that isn't that user's, with no existence leak.

post.description: Called by the Zennopay SDK after the user slides to pay. **Session-token only** — HMAC is not accepted. The session token must be the one issued for `{intent_id}`.
Cancel a not-yet-captured intent. Server-to-server only; requires HMAC. The partner identified by the HMAC key must own the intent.
Create a reusable bank destination in the authenticated tenant and environment. The full account number is never returned.
Validate, reserve prefund, and durably enqueue an asynchronous payout. A new payout returns 202; an identical idempotent replay returns the original payout with 200.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: False for a newly accepted payout.

200.description: Original payout returned for an identical idempotent replay

Idempotent-Replayed.description: True when the original payout is replayed.

get.description: List payouts visible in the authenticated tenant and environment, newest first, using opaque cursor pagination.
Retrieve the authoritative public state of a payout. Unknown, cross-tenant, and cross-environment identifiers return the same not-found error.

post.description: Request cancellation. Payouts v1 fails closed and returns payout_not_cancelable for every known payout because cancellation cannot currently be guaranteed.

hmacAuth.name: X-Zennopay-Signature
hmacAuth.description:
HMAC-SHA256 signature scheme. Four headers are required on every signed request: `X-Zennopay-Key-Id`, `X-Zennopay-Timestamp` (RFC 3339, ±5 min skew), `X-Zennopay-Nonce` (32-byte hex), and `X-Zennopay-Signature` (base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical request: `METHOD
PATH
TIMESTAMP
NONCE
SHA256_HEX(body)`). Requests must originate from an allowlisted source IP.

sessionToken.description: Zennopay-minted session token. Returned as `session_token` from POST /v1/payment_intents (and re-minted via POST /v1/payment_intents/{intent_id}/session). Short-lived, single-use for the confirming debit, and scoped to one intent. Opaque to partners — treat it as a bearer secret.

receiptToken.description: Zennopay-minted receipt token for reopening a receipt. Returned as `receipt_token` from POST /v1/payment_intents/{intent_id}/receipt_token. Audience `zennopay-receipt`, TTL 300s, read-only (authorizes only GET /receipt), reusable, and scoped to a user (not intent-bound) — it can open any of that user's receipts but no one else's.

HmacTimestamp.name: X-Zennopay-Timestamp
HmacTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Rejected if more than ±5 minutes off server time.

HmacNonce.name: X-Zennopay-Nonce
HmacNonce.description: Random 32-byte hex string (64 chars). Replays within 10 minutes are rejected.

HmacSignature.name: X-Zennopay-Signature
HmacSignature.description: Base64-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical request string.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional client-supplied idempotency key. Replaying the exact same request with the same key returns the original response.

PayoutModeHeader.name: X-Zennopay-Mode
PayoutModeHeader.description: Optional assertion of the credential environment. It cannot switch environments; a mismatch is rejected.

PayoutIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
PayoutIdempotencyKey.description: Required for payout creation. Reuse the same key for the same logical request across retries.

PayoutStatusQuery.name: status
PayoutStatusQuery.description: Return only payouts in this public status.

PayoutCreatedAfterQuery.name: created_after
PayoutCreatedAfterQuery.description: Return payouts created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

PayoutCreatedBeforeQuery.name: created_before
PayoutCreatedBeforeQuery.description: Return payouts created before this ISO 8601 timestamp. Must be later than created_after.

PayoutCursorQuery.name: cursor
PayoutCursorQuery.description: Opaque next_cursor value from the preceding page.

Corridor.description: QR Payments corridor. `vn_vietqr` is implemented subject to account enablement. `th_promptpay` is an API/QR-parsing preview and does not currently have payout execution enabled. Philippines/QR Ph is not exposed by v1.

IntentStatus.description: Lifecycle state of the payment intent.

CreateIntentRequest.description: Create-intent body. Send both attestations to receive a Zennopay-minted session token. Deployments explicitly provisioned for partner-minted session JWTs may omit both.

partner_user_id.description: Partner's opaque, stable user identifier — never a raw government ID. Zennopay never sees the underlying user PII; this is for partner-side correlation and per-user limit enforcement.

KycAttestation.description: Partner's per-payment KYC attestation, from the partner's real KYC system.

verified.description: Must be true; Zennopay will not move money otherwise.

id_type.description: Which government ID the user was KYC'd on, e.g. "passport". The raw ID number never crosses.

id_country.description: ISO country of the government ID, e.g. "IN".

SanctionsAttestation.description: Partner's per-payment sanctions attestation, from the partner's real screening system.

clean.description: Must be true; Zennopay will not move money otherwise.

screened_at.description: When the user was last sanctions-screened (ISO 8601).

LocalMinorUnits.description: Positive local-currency minor units. Clients should send the int64 string form.

SessionToken.description: A re-minted session token for an existing intent.

session_token.description: Zennopay-minted bearer session token for the SDK.

session_expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the token stops verifying.

ReceiptToken.description: A read-only, reusable, user-scoped receipt token.

receipt_token.description: Zennopay-minted bearer receipt token for the SDK's presentReceipt. Audience `zennopay-receipt`, TTL 300s.

receipt_token_expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the token stops verifying.

CreatedPaymentIntent.description: Create-intent response. Extends PaymentIntent with the Zennopay-minted session token.

session_token.description: Zennopay-minted bearer session token. Present when both attestations are supplied and session minting is enabled.

session_expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the optional session token stops verifying.

Receipt.description: Authoritative receipt for a payment, with live status. Returned by GET /v1/payment_intents/{intent_id}/receipt.

status.description: Live status at fetch time. Poll a `pending` receipt to a terminal state.

amount_usd_cents.description: USD amount debited from the user's wallet.

local_amount.description: Amount delivered to the merchant in local currency (minor-unit string), e.g. "3500000" VND.

merchant_name.description: Merchant display name from the scanned QR.

PayoutMoney.description: Non-negative whole minor units encoded as a base-10 signed-int64 string. VND uses whole dong.

amount.description: Positive whole minor units encoded as a base-10 signed-int64 string. VND uses whole dong.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when exhausted.

message.description: Generic public summary. Internal provider and compliance reasons are not exposed.
Generic public summary. Internal failure reasons are not exposed.

error.message: Request signature could not be verified.

AuthorizationFailed.description: 403 — Credentials valid but not authorized for this resource.

error.message: Not authorized to access this resource.

ValidationFailed.description: 400 — Request body or parameters failed validation.

Conflict.description: 409 — Operation conflicts with current resource state.

error.message: Resource is in a conflicting state.

PayoutInvalidRequest.description: 400 — Payout request body, query, mode assertion, or beneficiary failed validation.

PayoutNotFound.description: 404 — No payout is visible in the authenticated tenant and environment.

PayoutConflict.description: 409 — The idempotency key conflicts or the payout cannot be cancelled.

error.message: Idempotency key was already used for a different request.

PayoutUnprocessable.description: 422 — The request is valid JSON but cannot be accepted under destination, currency, balance, risk, compliance, or route controls.

PayoutUnavailable.description: 503 — A required Platform Payouts dependency is unavailable or unconfigured.
